parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, made of plastic, typically cylindrical and hollow to fit over the pen tip. It measures around 5 cm in length and 1.2 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip from drying out and prevents ink leakage. It may also have a clip for attaching the pen to pockets or notebooks.
parts.Movement_description: The cap can be removed or attached by pulling or snapping it onto the pen body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, cylindrical in shape, approximately 14 cm long and 1.2 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: The base body houses the ink reservoir and provides the main gripping area for writing. It connects to the pen tip and may hold the ink cartridge inside.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is stationary during use but can be held and rotated by the user for comfortable writing.
